newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Benelux in final stage of injection talk.
newsitem.headline: Benelux in final stage of injection talk.

text.p: Data storage products maker Benelux International Ltd said it was in the final stage of talks in relation to a proposed capital injection and debt restructuring.

"Negotiation on a proposal involving an injection of new capital and a restructuring of bank indebtedness betweeen the company, a potential investor and the banks is now in its final stage," said Benelux chairman Chau Kar Sun in a statement.

Chau said the proposal has been accepted in principle by the company and the potential investor, and the company's bankers had also agreed to extend a standstill agreement by another month to January 31 1997.
Trading in Benelux shares, which has been suspended since February 5, 1996, will remain suspended pending further notice.
